qualification.rung_1: mean of blockers over samples 1, 2 and 3 >= 1; since samples 1-2 each have 1, rung 1 qualifies iff sample 3 has at least 1 blocker (an empty completed patch counts 1, R47)
qualification.rung_1_fails: sample 3 has 0 blockers; its direct_task fails other than by infrastructure; its review fails twice other than by infrastructure; or rung 1 is rejected for contamination
qualification.rung_2: considered only if rung 1 does not qualify: its recorded mean 2.5 >= 1.5 qualifies without extension and without any new run
qualification.stop: stop at the first of rungs 1-2 that qualifies; no rung 3 or 4 run and no further rung is considered

halt_without_result: the continuation stops and is reported to the owner without a rung if: a reused sha256 or the runtime, package or compare_base check fails; a generated command's --dry-run exits non-zero or leaves a run root or call record; the Codex CLI is not codex-cli 0.162.1 or bwrap is missing; the unqualified import of orchestrator resolves to a path other than the Task 8 worktree .worktrees/omp-i1-prerequisites (only the path is compared; its Task 8 HEAD was never recorded); or the budget gate forbids the next call
hidden_fraction: measured once for sample 3 with summarize.hidden_failures from the runtime above, as the base criterion defines it; void unless this pool's upstream anchor passes all 164 nodes; descriptive only, never a qualification condition
budget_worst_case: 1 direct_task (4 h) and 1 review_once (1.5 h), plus at most one contamination replacement in total (a second contaminated rung-1 run rejects the rung) and one non-infrastructure review rerun: at most 4 runs, one live at a time
